usedFor: Kanban Zone tracks work as cards, and Freshsales Classic receives a sales record when “New Card Created” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Card Created” in Kanban Zone, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new card opens a deal tied to an account, so the pipeline starts from the board.

watchOut: “Card Is Moved” fires on every move, so pairing it with “Create Deal” would open duplicate deals.
